nodes.label: Sprint Structure
nodes.rationale: 1-week sprints with daily 6-hour productive capacity per developer, 20% buffer for unplanned work, 80% commitment rate

nodes.label: Story Points Estimation
nodes.rationale: Fibonacci-like scale (1,2,3,5,8,13) based on complexity not time, ~3 hours per point, split stories over 8 points

nodes.label: Git Workflow
nodes.rationale: Feature branch workflow with protected main/develop branches, conventional commits, PR requirements (approval + CI checks)

nodes.label: Incident Response Process
nodes.rationale: Severity-based SLAs (L0: immediate, L1: 1hr), blameless post-mortems focused on process improvement

nodes.label: File Naming Conventions
nodes.rationale: kebab-case for components/hooks/utilities, descriptive suffixes (.types.ts, .constants.ts) for type definition files

nodes.label: Component Structure Pattern
nodes.rationale: Strict ordering: imports → types → component → hooks → effects → handlers → derived values → render, 'use client' only when needed

nodes.label: Import Order Convention
nodes.rationale: React core → third-party → shadcn/ui → local components → hooks → utilities → types, enables easy dependency scanning

nodes.label: Styling Conventions
nodes.rationale: Priority: Tailwind utilities > shadcn variants > CSS variables > inline (dynamic only), game-* prefix for custom utilities

nodes.label: TypeScript Conventions
nodes.rationale: Interface for object shapes, type for unions/aliases, extend shadcn props, descriptive generic names, strict mode enabled

nodes.label: State Management Strategy
nodes.rationale: Local: useState/useReducer, Shared: Zustand, Server: TanStack Query via tRPC, clear separation of concerns

nodes.label: Performance Optimization
nodes.rationale: Code split heavy components, memoize expensive computations/callbacks, use transform for GPU-accelerated animations

nodes.label: Accessibility Standards
nodes.rationale: ARIA labels on interactive elements, keyboard navigation support, WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1), semantic HTML

nodes.label: Testing Conventions
nodes.rationale: Test user behavior not implementation, prefer role-based queries, meaningful test names, Testing Library patterns

nodes.label: Security Practices
nodes.rationale: Avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML, sanitize with DOMPurify, never log sensitive data, use env vars, tRPC handles CSRF

nodes.label: Color System
nodes.rationale: OKLCH color space for consistency, --game-* prefix, hierarchical backgrounds/borders/text, semantic status colors, accent colors for decoration

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: Inter (UI), Rajdhani (display), JetBrains Mono (code), Tailwind scale with custom sizes, weight hierarchy (400-700), WCAG contrast compliance

nodes.label: Spacing System
nodes.rationale: Tailwind 4px base scale, component-specific presets (input/button/card padding), section gaps (28/40px), mobile-first approach

nodes.label: Border Radius Scale
nodes.rationale: 6px (sm) → 8px (md buttons/inputs) → 12px (lg cards) → 16px (xl modals) → 9999px (full pills/badges)

nodes.label: Animation & Motion
nodes.rationale: Duration-fast (150ms) → normal (200ms) → slow (400ms), custom easing (ease-game, ease-bounce), respect prefers-reduced-motion, GPU-accelerated transforms only

nodes.label: Component States
nodes.rationale: Defined states for buttons/inputs/cards (default, hover, active, focus, disabled/error), loading/empty/error state patterns with skeleton/spinners

nodes.label: Responsive Design
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first approach, Tailwind breakpoints (sm:640, md:768, lg:1024, xl:1280, 2xl:1536), responsive containers/grids/typography patterns

nodes.label: Accessibility Design
nodes.rationale: Focus-visible rings, ARIA labels, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, skip links

nodes.label: Dark Mode Implementation
nodes.rationale: Dark-first design for gaming platform, CSS variables for automatic switching, consistent component support
